blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
blocks.zh: 模型架构塑造了LLMs的缩放行为,培训效率和推论成本,使其成为业界和学术界的中心焦点. 在工业上,DeepSeek、Quen和Kimi背后的团队经常推出建筑创新,但公开报道很少记录哪些想法成功,这些想法被抛弃,以及为什么。 在学术界,有限的计算和不一致的基线往往将评价限于小规模的单一点比较,因此难以确定改进是在更大的尺度上进行还是转化为更广泛的影响。 ArchSpace作为记录、审查和参考建筑重建的公共平台处理这两个漏洞:每个提案都与其实验和推理一起记录,由社区审查,并在以后的工作中参考。 为了在成本高昂的大规模培训之前评价各种想法,ArchSpace利用了缩放定律,从较小的实验中预测更大的模型损失,这是工业中广泛采用的做法。 我们提供了使该平台能够使用的初始参考文献:Quen3.5和OLMo3基线,配有缩放定律,以及可重复使用的培训方法。 通过这次审查验证出来的想法反过来可以成为新的基线,ArchSpace因此旨在扩大塑造下一代模型的构想范围.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Architecture forms the foundation of a large language model (LLM), shaping its performance, scaling behavior, and efficiency during training and inference. When teams such as DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi release new open models, they also introduce architectural changes and innovations. Validating these designs involves costly training experiments. However, the experiments and trade-offs behind most models remain inaccessible, leaving the community with little account of which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. An open and complete record of validation would therefore be as valuable to subsequent research as a new idea itself.
blocks.zh: 架构构成大型语言模型(LLM)的基础,塑造其性能,缩放行为,以及在培训和推论期间的效率. 当DeepSeek,Quen,Kimi等团队发布新的开放模型时,他们也引入了建筑变革和创新. 验证这些设计需要昂贵的培训实验。 然而,大多数模型背后的实验和权衡仍然不可考取,使得社区对哪些思想成功,哪些思想被抛弃,以及为什么,几乎没有什么说明. 因此,公开和完整的验证记录对随后的研究来说,与新想法本身一样,也是有价值的。

blocks.en: The value of such records also depends on whether researchers discover the documented ideas and build on them. However, much of the attention to new architectures is concentrated on research from industry: our survey 1 1 1 See Appendix F for survey details. shows that academic work accounts for about a third of the papers but receives less than 10% of the citations (Figure 1 ). Academic ideas need greater visibility and proper validation so that the community can discuss these ideas and draw inspiration from them, and even explore new architectural designs on these bases.
blocks.zh: 这种记录的价值还取决于研究者是否发现并借鉴了文献记载的构想。 然而,对新建筑的大部分关注集中于工业研究:我们的调查 11 1 F指调查细节. 表明学术工作约占论文的三分之一,但收到的引用不到10%(图1)。 学术思想需要更高的知名度和适当的验证,以便社区能够讨论这些思想并从中汲取灵感,甚至在这些基础上探索新的建筑设计.

blocks.en: We therefore introduce ArchSpace, a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Research . Each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community to check whether the results support the conclusion, and referenced by later work. To evaluate the architectural changes described in each proposal, the validation framework uses scaling laws [ 13 , 9 ] to compare models across multiple compute budgets, a systematic and standard practice widely used in industry [ 20 , 6 , 5 , 16 , 11 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们介绍ArchSpace,这是一个用于记录、审查和参考建筑研究的公共平台。 每项提案都记录在实验和推理中,由社区审查,检查结果是否支持结论,并在以后的工作中予以参考。 为了评价每项提案中描述的建筑变化,验证框架采用缩放法[13,9]来比较跨多个计算预算的模型,这是工业中广泛采用的系统标准做法[20,6,5,16,11,17].

blocks.en: As initial references, we provide Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines. Validated architecture innovations can in turn become new baselines for later work. ArchSpace aims to build a community around these contributions, where the research process is openly documented and a wider range of ideas can gain visibility and recognition.
blocks.zh: 作为初步参考,我们提供了Quen3.5和OLMo3基线。 经过验证的建筑创新可反过来成为今后工作的新基线。 ArchSpace旨在围绕这些贡献建立一个社区,在社区中,研究过程被公开记录下来,更广泛的想法可以获得知名度和认可.

blocks.en: 2 An Open Community for Architecture Research
blocks.zh: 2 建筑研究开放社区

blocks.en: ArchSpace aims to build an open community for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Research . Each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community to check whether the results support the conclusion, and referenced by later work.
blocks.zh: ArchSpace旨在为记录、审查和参考建筑研究建立一个开放的社区。 每项提案都记录在实验和推理中,由社区审查,检查结果是否支持结论,并在以后的工作中予以参考。

blocks.en: Contributing to ArchSpace begins with an Architecture Proposal issue, which states the proposed change, its rationale, the baseline, and the validation plan (Figure 2 ). Community discussion helps contributors refine the architectural idea and plan a fair comparison with the baseline. Contributors then implement and evaluate the proposed architecture under the validation framework (Section 3 ) and submit their work for public review through a pull request (PR) linked to the issue. The PR links to the implementation, configurations, checkpoints, training logs, evaluation results, and reproduction instructions. It also records failed trials and search choices so readers can trace how the conclusion was reached. Community reviewers then use this record to check whether the implementation matches the proposal, the comparison is reproducible, and the experiments support the conclusion. The verified PR is then merged into ArchSpace for future reference, and the proposed architecture can serve as a new baseline.
blocks.zh: 对ArchSpace的贡献始于一个建筑建议问题,其中说明了拟议的改变、其理由、基线和验证计划(图2)。 社区讨论有助于贡献者完善建筑理念,并计划与基线进行公平的比较. 撰稿人随后执行和评价验证框架(第3节)下的拟议架构,并通过与该问题有关的拉动请求将其工作提交公众审查。 公共关系与执行、配置、检查站、培训记录、评价结果和复制指示相联系。 它还记录了失败的试验和搜索选择,以便读者可以追踪结论是如何达成的. 社区审查人员然后使用这一记录检查执行是否与提案相符,比较可以复制,实验支持结论. 之后经过核实的PR被合并到ArchSpace中供日后参考,拟议的架构可以作为新的基准.

blocks.en: Our broader aim is for reviewed PRs to have the same standing as traditional research papers and become the primary way to communicate and cite contributions in ArchSpace. A PR combines a complete account of the contribution with direct links to the resources needed to reproduce and extend the work. Follow-up PRs can link to earlier contributions, so researchers can trace how architectural ideas develop across studies. By bringing these contributions together, ArchSpace aims to provide a shared foundation for subsequent architecture research.
blocks.zh: 我们更广泛的目标是让经过审查的公关与传统研究论文具有同等地位,成为ArchSpace传播和引用贡献的主要途径。 公关将完整的贡献说明与复制和扩大工作所需资源直接挂钩。 后续行动 PR可以链接到早期的贡献,因此研究人员可以追踪建筑理念如何在研究中发展. 通过把这些贡献汇集在一起,ArchSpace旨在为之后的建筑研究提供一个共同的基础.

blocks.en: 3 The ArchSpace Validation Framework
blocks.zh: 3. ArchSpace验证框架

blocks.en: ArchSpace standardizes architecture comparisons through a two-phase validation framework (Figure 2 ). Phase I tests whether the proposed architecture improves the compute–loss trend across the five budgets of the scaling ladder. Phase II trains 1B models on 150B+10B tokens to test whether the gain persists through longer training and to evaluate downstream capabilities directly.
blocks.zh: ArchSpace通过两个阶段的验证框架(图2 )使架构比较标准化. 第一阶段检验拟议架构是否改进了规模阶梯五个预算的计算-损失趋势。 二期在150B+10B令牌上进行1B型列车,以测试增益是否通过较长的训练持续,并直接评价下游能力.

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of the architectural change, the proposed architecture and its baseline use the same training data, tokenizer, and validation data in both phases. The ArchSpace training dataset provides official OLMo 3 mixtures pre-tokenized with the OLMo 3 tokenizer [ 19 ] . 2 2 2 Tokenizer identifier: allenai/dolma2-tokenizer . In our training dataset, the data for pretraining in both phases come from the Dolma 3 Pool 150B sample , and the data for Phase II long-context mid-training come from the Dolma 3 Longmino Mix (50B) .
blocks.zh: 为了隔离建筑变化的影响,拟议建筑及其基线在两个阶段都使用相同的培训数据、标注器和验证数据。 ArchSpace训练数据集提供官方OLMo 3的混合物与OLMo 3的标致器预切分 [19]. 2 2 2 Tokenizer标识器: Alllenai/dolma2-tokenizer . 在我们的培训数据集中,两个阶段的预训数据来自Dolma 3 Pool 150B样本,第二阶段的长文中训数据来自Dolma 3 Longmino Mix(50B).

blocks.en: 3.1 Phase I: Scaling across compute budgets
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 第一阶段:跨计算预算的扩大

blocks.en: Architectural gains can vary with the compute budget, so Phase I validates the proposed architecture against its baseline across multiple budgets using fitted scaling laws that estimate each architecture’s lowest achievable loss [ 13 , 9 ] . The proposed architecture is considered an improvement if its compute-optimal loss curve lies on the Pareto frontier. The validation loss L L used for fitting is computed as the equal-weight average over the eleven domains of the original OLMo 3 validation set [ 19 ] (Appendix C ). Throughout the report, loss refers to this validation loss.
blocks.zh: 建筑收益随计算预算而变化,因此,第一阶段在多个预算的基线上,通过适当的比例法验证拟议建筑,估计每个建筑的最低可实现损失[13、9]。 如果其计算-最佳损失曲线位于Pareto前沿,则拟议架构被视为一种改进。 用于装配的L L 验证损失是按原OLMo 3验证集[19](附录C)的11个域的等重平均值计算的。 在整个报告中,损失是指这一审定损失。

blocks.en: We provide three settings that differ in the scope of hyperparameter search. Broader searches require more training runs and therefore a larger total FLOPs budget. When the proposed architecture is similar to its baseline, the optimal learning rate (LR) and batch size (BS) can also be similar for the two architectures. The baseline’s search results can then be reused to reduce the cost of validation. The choice of setting therefore depends on the extent of the architectural change and the available compute.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了三种在超参数搜索范围上不同的设置. 扩大搜索范围需要更多的培训,因此需要更多的FLOP预算。 当拟议架构与其基线相似时,两种架构的最佳学习率(LR)和批量大小(BS)也可以相似. 然后可以重新使用基线的搜索结果,以减少验证费用。 因此,设置的选择取决于建筑变化的程度和可用的计算.

blocks.en: At each budget of the scaling ladder, Setting 1 reuses the baseline’s compute-optimal settings, including model size, training token count, LR, and BS. Setting 2 performs an IsoFLOP sweep over model size and training token count while reusing the baseline’s LR and BS. Setting 3 additionally tunes LR and BS during the IsoFLOP sweep (Figure 2 ).

This comparison identifies the combination of model size and training tokens that gives the lowest loss at that budget. Setting 2 searches four to six model sizes at each budget of the scaling ladder. The selected sizes should bracket the expected optimum for the proposed architecture. blocks.en: 3.2 Phase II: Training 1B models on 150B+10B tokens
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 第二阶段:培训150B+10B标志的1B型号.

blocks.en: Phase II tests whether gains measured on the scaling ladder persist through longer training and context extension, and evaluates downstream capabilities. The framework adopts 1B parameters as a reasonable model size for this evaluation, with pretraining on about 150B tokens at 8K context followed by long-context mid-training on 10B tokens at 64K. 4 4 4 Context length and BS use binary multiples ( 1 ​ K = 2 10 1\mathrm{K}=2^{10} ); token and parameter counts use decimal multiples ( 1 ​ B = 10 9 1\mathrm{B}=10^{9} ).
blocks.zh: 第二阶段通过延长培训时间和扩展环境,测试在梯级上衡量的收益是否继续存在,并评估下游的能力。 框架采用1B参数作为本评价的合理模型大小,在8K背景下对约150B个信使进行预训,然后在64K背景下对10B信使进行长编中训. 4 4 上下文长度和 BS 使用二进制倍数(1 K = 2 10 1\mathrm{K}=2^{10}); 符号和参数计数使用小数倍数(1 B = 10 9 1\mathrm{B}=10^{9}).

blocks.en: For pretraining, the LR and BS predicted by the Phase I scaling laws provide a good starting point for hyperparameter search. In practice, the predicted optima differ from the best measured settings, so we conduct a further search over LR and BS. We then use the selected pretrained checkpoint for long-context mid-training and tune LR and BS with the pretraining settings as a reference (Section 5 ). As in Phase I, researchers can directly reuse the tuned settings, or run their own search when additional compute is available.
blocks.zh: 就预训而言,第一阶段缩放定律预测的LR和BS为超参数搜索提供了一个良好的起点。 在实践中,预测的opitima与最佳测量的设置不同,因此我们在LR和BS上进行进一步搜索. 然后,我们使用选定的预先训练的检查站进行长文中训和调子LR和BS,并使用预先训练的设置作为参考(第5节)。 和第一阶段一样,研究人员可以直接重复调制设置,或者在可获得额外计算时进行自己的搜索.

blocks.en: Runs are compared at the final checkpoint of each training stage, after its LR schedule completes, because intermediate rankings can reverse during LR decay (Appendix E.3 ). Downstream capabilities are evaluated with OLMES [ 7 ] 5 5 5 https://github.com/allenai/olmes using the evaluation suites introduced in OLMo 3 [ 19 ] . After pretraining, the Base Main suite tests general capabilities, involving mathematical reasoning and question answering. After long-context mid-training, evaluation focuses on the Base Long-Context suite, with RULER [ 10 ] as the primary development signal and HELMET [ 29 ] for complementary evaluation. The Base Main suite is also rerun to check whether the capabilities developed during pretraining are retained. blocks.en: 4 Phase I: Baseline Ladders and Scaling Laws
blocks.zh: 页:1 第一阶段:基线梯子和扩大法律

blocks.en: Hybrid architectures have become a mainstream design choice for LLMs. We therefore select Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 as baselines. Qwen3.5 interleaves three Gated DeltaNet layers [ 28 ] with one full-attention layer [ 24 ] , whereas OLMo3 interleaves three sliding-window attention layers with one full-attention layer [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 混合建筑已经成为LLMS的主流设计选择. 因此,我们选择Quen3.5和OLMo3作为基线。 Quen3.5 互叶 3 Gated DeltaNet 层 [28] 与1 个全注层 [24] ,而 OLMo3 互叶 3 个滑窗 关注层 与1 个全注层 [19] .

blocks.en: For each architecture, we provide a baseline ladder : a series of models trained at the five compute budgets of the scaling ladder, with LR and BS swept within each model–budget group. We fit a scaling law to each ladder’s measured losses to obtain the compute-optimal model size and training token count, together with predicted optima. We then test the loss predictions on extrapolation runs at larger budgets to validate the effectiveness of the fitted scaling laws.
blocks.zh: 对于每个架构,我们提供一个基线阶梯:一系列模型在缩放阶梯的五个计算预算中得到训练,其中LR和BS横扫在每个模型-预算组内. 我们用一个缩放定律来衡量每个梯子的测量损失,以便获得计算-最佳模型大小和训练符号计数以及预测的Otopima。 然后,我们用更大的预算来测试外推的损失预测,以验证适当的缩放法的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: The models in both ladders are pretrained on the Dolma 3 Pool 150B sample using the shared OLMo 3 tokenizer (Section 3 ) and 8K-token sequences. Training combines Muon [ 12 , 15 ] with AdamW (Appendix B.1 ) under a warmup–stable–decay (WSD) schedule [ 11 ] , with a square-root cooldown over the final 20% of updates [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 这两个梯子中的模型在Dolma 3 Pool 150B样本上使用共享的OLMo 3 代碼器(第3节)和8K-token序列进行预训. 训练将穆恩[12,15]与亚当W(Appendix B.1 )结合,按照暖和-稳定-decay(WSD)时间表[11],在最后20%的更新[8]上进行平方根冷却.

blocks.en: Following Phase I Setting 3 (Section 3.1 ), we conduct IsoFLOP experiments by sweeping an outer grid of model sizes and compute budgets (Figure 3 ). Within each model–budget group, we further sweep an inner grid of LR and BS to find the best hyperparameters (Figures 4 and 9 ). Appendices A and B specify the model sizes and LR–BS grids for each ladder.

blocks.zh: 我们下次通过使用梯级培训设置和验证数据冻结安装的系数和培训模型,在更大的预算中测试损失预测(图5和表4)。 这些运行使用了最大的横扫模型和新的32层模型,在模型大小和训练符号计数的计算-最佳组合附近受训,最高可达最大横扫预算的十倍.

blocks.en: The best measured loss at each swept budget lies within 0.5% of the compute-optimal curve of L ∗ L^{*} , and the extrapolation losses follow this curve beyond the swept range (Figure 5 ). At the LR and BS used in training, the frozen scaling laws also predict the extrapolation losses within 0.5%, with a MAPE of 0.32% (Table 4 ), comparable to the MAPE on the swept runs. Appendix C.5 gives the training recipes and compares predictions from L ∗ L^{*} alone with those from the full scaling law.

blocks.en: Finally, we compare the predicted optimal LR and BS with the best measured configuration in each model–budget group (Table 22 ). The predicted optimal LR, however, differs from the best measured LR with a MAPE of 35.1% for Qwen3.5 and 23.1% for OLMo3. The Setting 3 search should therefore be initialized with these predicted optima, and the final recipe should be selected using the measured losses. Appendices D.3 and D.4 examine how alternative LR–BS forms and methods for estimating the optima affect prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们将预测的最佳LR和BS与每个模型-预算组中衡量得最好的配置进行比较(表22)。 然而,预测的最佳LR与最佳测得的LR不同,Qwen3.5的MAPE为35.1%,OLMo3为23.1%。 因此,设定3搜索应当以这些预测的Otitima初始化,最后的食谱应当使用测定的损失选择. 附录D.3和D.4审查备选的LR-BS形式和估计opima的方法如何影响预测准确性。

blocks.en: We also use the predicted optima to initialize the LR–BS search for the longer pretraining in Phase II (Figure 6 ). To compare training length across model sizes, we use tokens per parameter (TPP), D / N D/N , where N N is the parameter count excluding the input embedding. The extrapolation runs follow the fitted compute-optimal path to larger models and budgets while remaining in the TPP range of the ladders. In contrast, Phase II pretraining uses about 130–160 TPP, compared with 10–14 TPP in the longest ladder runs at the Phase II model scales. This combination of model scale and token exposure lies outside the swept range, so we search over LR and BS directly in Phase II (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with scaling laws from prior work
blocks.zh: 4.4 与以往工作的缩放法比较

blocks.en: We next compare the coupled and additive base surfaces within each study that reports both (Table 5 ). In our baseline ladders and in prior work, the coupled form matches the measured losses more closely than the additive form. The fitted coupling exponents are γ M ​ D = 0.51 \gamma_{MD}=0.51 for Qwen3.5 and 0.40 for OLMo3, compared with 0.31–0.41 for Skaling and 0.41 for OpenEuroLLM.

blocks.en: We also compare laws for optimal LR and BS, evaluating each law from prior work on the path for which it is defined (Table 6 and Figure 7 ). At a fixed model scale, optimal BS follows a power law in data size with fitted exponents from 0.46 to 0.57 (Table 6 ), close to the D 1 / 2 D^{1/2} prediction derived from the Muon-type proxy [ 25 ] in Appendix C.1 . The fitted power laws for B ∗ B^{*} also have a negative exponent in M M for each baseline ladder (Table 2 ); the optimal BS therefore depends on both M M and D D (Table 19 ). By contrast, the optimal-LR exponents vary more across studies, whose optimizers, schedules, and parameterizations differ. We therefore fit a separate LR law to each baseline ladder.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较各项法律,以优化LR和BS,根据以往的工作情况评估每项法律的定义(表6和图7)。 在固定的模型尺度上,最佳BS遵循一个数据大小的功率定律,配备了0.46至0.57(表6),接近附录C.1中的Muon型代词[25]的D 1/2 D^{1/2}预测。 B *B 的配套权力法对每个基准梯级的M M也有负比值(表2);因此,最佳的BS取决于M M和D D (表19)。 相比之下,最佳LR指数在不同的研究中差异较大,其优化者,时间表和参数化不同. 因此,我们每个基线梯子都配有单独的LR法。

blocks.en: 4.5 Implications for the validation framework
blocks.zh: 4.5 对审定框架的影响

blocks.en: The settings of Section 3.1 reuse the baseline ladders in two ways. Settings 1 and 2 use the best measured recipes of the nearest model–budget groups (Appendix B ), and Setting 3 starts its LR–BS search from the predicted optima (Appendix C.4 ). At a BS imposed by hardware, the search starts from the predicted optimal LR at that BS, given by Equation 12 in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 第3.1节的设置以两种方式重新利用基线梯子。 设置 1 和 2 使用最近模型- 预算组( Appendix B ) 的最佳测量食谱, 设置 3 从 optima (Appendix C.4 ) 开始 LR- BS 搜索 。 在硬件强加的BS中,搜索从该BS的预测最佳LR开始,由附录C.1中的方程式12给出.

blocks.en: Phase II pretraining uses much higher token counts at the 1B scale (Section 4.3 ). Its direct LR–BS search also starts from the predicted optima (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 第二阶段的预训在1B级使用高得多的代号计数(第4.3节)。 它的直接LR-BS搜索也从预测的opima(第5节)开始.

blocks.en: 5 Phase II: 1B Baselines and Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 页:1 阶段 二:1B 基线和培训

blocks.en: To provide reusable baselines for the longer training and downstream evaluation in Phase II (Section 3.2 ), we train 1B Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 models on 150B tokens at 8K context, followed by 10B tokens of long-context mid-training at 64K. Both baselines use the same data, token counts, and schedules within each training stage. We tune LR and BS for Qwen3.5, then reuse the selected baseline recipe for OLMo3 without tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了在第二阶段(第3.2节)为较长的培训和下游评价提供可重复使用的基线,我们在8K背景的150B标志上培训1B Quen3.5和OLMo3型号,然后在64K条件下培训10B长文中级训练。 这两种基线在每个培训阶段都使用相同的数据、指示数和时间表。 我们为Qwen3.5调制LR和BS,然后重复使用OLMo3的选定基准食谱而不调制.

blocks.en: Validation loss and downstream task scores favor different recipes. We therefore select recipes from the Pareto frontier using validation loss and the Base Main score for pretraining, and long-context scores and the Base Main score for mid-training. Section 5.3 reports the baselines’ downstream evaluation results; Table 8 reports the complete pretraining sweep; Appendix E gives the configurations and detailed analyses, including the complete mid-training sweep.
blocks.zh: 验证损失和下游任务分数偏好不同的食谱. 因此,我们从帕雷托边疆选择食谱,使用验证损失和Base Main的分数进行预训,长文分数和Base Main的分数进行中训. 第5.3节报告了基线的下游评价结果; 表8报告了完整的训练前扫描; 附录E提供了配置和详细分析,包括完整的训练中扫描。

blocks.en: 5.1 Pretraining beyond the compute-optimal ladder
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 预训超越计算-优化阶梯

blocks.en: The Qwen3.5 pretraining run reaches about 130 TPP, compared with about 10 TPP in the longest ladder run at this model scale. We tune LR and BS for this longer training, starting from the predicted optima of the frozen scaling law (Table 7 ). At BS 4M, the predicted optimal LR is about 8e-4. Table 8 gives the complete sweep, with loss predictions and Base Main scores.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5预训运行达到约130 TPP,而本型号运行时间最长的梯级运行中则有约10 TPP. 我们从冷冻缩放定律的预言(表7)开始, 在BS 4M,预测的最佳LR约为8e-4. 表8给出了完整的扫描,并附有损失预测和Base Main分数.

L L and L ^ \widehat{L} are the measured and predicted losses for runs using the baseline recipe in Table 23 ; relative error is L ^ / L − 1 \widehat{L}/L-1 .

blocks.en: The final loss of every pretraining run is within 1% of the lowest measured loss, yet the lowest loss and the highest Base Main score occur at different recipes. The selected recipe uses LR 3e-3 and BS 4M (Table 8 ); its LR is about 3.6 times the predicted optimum at the same BS. This choice relies on results from the final checkpoints of completed schedules: lower-LR runs have lower loss during the stable phase, but the run with the selected higher-LR recipe has the lowest loss after the final decay (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 每一次预训赛的最后亏损都在所测最低亏损的1%以内,然而最低亏损和最高的Base Main分则发生在不同的食谱上. 选定的食谱使用LR 3e-3和BS 4M(表8);其LR大约是同一BS的预测最佳的3.6倍. 这一选择依赖于已完成时刻表的最后检查点的结果:低LR运行在稳定阶段损失较少,但使用选定的较高LR运行的运行在最终衰败后损失最少(附录E.3).

blocks.en: The pretraining runs also test predictions outside the fitting regime: they extend beyond their baseline ladders in TPP and use a different warmup schedule (Appendix E.2 ). The frozen Qwen3.5 scaling law overpredicts every pretraining loss, with a MAPE of about 1% (Appendix E.2 ). For OLMo3, the scaling law predicts the baseline loss within 0.6% (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 预训还运行在适配制外的测试预测:它们超越了TPP的基线阶梯,并使用不同的热量表(附录E.2.). 被冻结的Quen3.5缩放法对每次预训损失都作了过度预测,MAPE约为1%(附录E.2). 对于OLMo3, 缩放法预测基线损失为0.6%(表7)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Long-context mid-training
blocks.zh: 5.2 长期培训

blocks.en: We then extend the pretrained model’s context window to 64K through long-context mid-training. The Qwen3.5 sweep tests peak LR values from the final pretraining LR to the pretraining peak, using the pretraining BS of 4M and a doubled BS of 8M. Each run restores the model and optimizer state of the selected pretrained checkpoint and trains on the same 10B tokens.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们通过长文中训将预训模型的上下文窗口扩展至64K。 Quen3.5扫描测试从最后的预训LR到预训峰值的LR峰值,采用预训BS4M和双倍的BS8M. 每次运行都会在相同的10B令牌上恢复所选预训检查站和列车的型号和优化状态.

blocks.en: Using RULER as the primary development signal (Section 3.2 ), we select LR 1e-3 and BS 4M for mid-training (Figure 8 and Table 25 ). At 64K, the length targeted by Phase II, this recipe yields the highest RULER score: 57.0, compared with 51.9 when mid-training uses the final pretraining LR (Table 9 ). The sweep also shows that the LR yielding the highest measured score is higher at BS 8M than at BS 4M for both RULER and HELMET at 64K (Appendix E.4 ). The baseline recipe combines the selected settings for pretraining and mid-training: peak LR 3e-3 with BS 4M for pretraining, followed by 1e-3 with BS 4M for long-context mid-training (Table 23 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用RULAR作为初级发展信号(第3.2节),选择LR 1e-3和BS 4M进行中训(图8和表25.)。 在第二阶段所定的长度为64K时,这种配方得出了欧盟驻科法治团最高的分数:57.0,而中训使用最后预训LR时则为51.9(表9)。 扫描还显示,在BS 8M的LR得分最高,比在BS 4M的LULR和HELMET都高(附录E.4. 基准食谱将预训和中训的选定设置结合起来:峰值LR 3e-3与BS 4M进行预训,之后1e-3与BS 4M进行长篇中训(表23).

blocks.en: The Qwen3.5 search across both training stages costs about 1.6 × 10 22 1.6\times 10^{22} FLOPs. By comparison, reusing the selected recipe for a single run of both stages costs about 1.47 × 10 21 1.47\times 10^{21} FLOPs for Qwen3.5 and 1.24 × 10 21 1.24\times 10^{21} FLOPs for OLMo3, each less than a tenth of the search cost.
blocks.zh: 横跨两个训练阶段的Quen3.5搜索费用约为1.6×10 22 1.6\times 10^{22}FLOPs. 相比之下,重用两个阶段单跑的选定配方大约花费1.47×10 21 1.47\time 10××××21] Quen3.5和1.24×10 21 1.24\time 10××××21) OLMo3的FLOP,每款不足搜索成本的十分之一.

blocks.en: 5.3 Baseline capability results
blocks.zh: 5.3 基线能力结果

blocks.en: We next present downstream evaluation results for the pretrained and mid-trained checkpoints of both baselines on the Base Main and Base Long-Context suites of OLMo 3 [ 19 ] . Qwen3.5 uses the selected recipe, and OLMo3 reuses it without tuning. OLMo3 uses about 16% less compute across the two training stages and a different inference implementation. The analysis therefore focuses on changes across training stages within each baseline.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将介绍对基地主干线和基地长文套装(OLMo 3[19])两个基线的预先培训和中试检查站的下游评价结果。 Quen3.5使用所选的食谱,OLMo3再用不调音. OLMo3在两个培训阶段使用大约16%的计算率和不同的推论执行率. 因此,分析的重点是每个基线内各个培训阶段的变化。

blocks.en: The Base Main score gives equal weight to Math, multiple-choice STEM (MC-STEM), multiple-choice non-STEM (MC-NonSTEM), and generative QA (GenQA); code tasks are excluded. Within each family, task and subtask scores are averaged with equal weights at each level according to the OLMES hierarchy. Base Main evaluation uses an input limit of 8K after pretraining and 64K after mid-training.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Shared baselines and documented evaluations support reproducible model comparisons. OLMo 3 [ 19 ] releases training data, recipes, and intermediate checkpoints, while OLMES [ 7 ] standardizes evaluation choices that affect comparisons between models. Using OLMo 3 data and OLMES evaluation, ArchSpace connects reusable architecture baselines to a continuing public contribution process: proposals, implementations, experimental records, reasoning, and reviews remain linked for later citation and reuse (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 共同基线和有文件记录的评价支持可复制模型的比较。 OLMO 3 [19] 发布培训数据,食谱和中间检查站,而OLMES [7] 规范了影响模型比较的评价选择. 利用OLMo 3数据和OLMES评价,ArchSpace将可重复使用的建筑基线与持续的公众贡献过程联系起来:提案、执行、实验记录、推理和审查仍然与以后的引用和再利用相联系(第2节)。

blocks.en: Kaplan et al. [13] established power-law relationships between language-model loss, model size, data, and compute. Chinchilla [ 9 ] used IsoFLOP profiles and an additive loss surface to determine compute-optimal model sizes and training token counts. DeepSeek LLM [ 5 ] represented model scale by non-embedding FLOPs per token, while Porian et al. [23] showed how output-layer compute, warmup, and optimizer tuning explain discrepancies in compute-optimal scaling. These studies provide the basis for Phase I’s IsoFLOP comparisons with consistent accounting of training FLOPs (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: Kaplan et al. [13] 在语言模型损失,模型大小,数据,和计算之间建立了权力法关系. Chinchilla [9] 使用IsoFLOP剖面图和添加剂损失表面来确定计算-最佳模型尺寸和训练符号计数。 DeepSeek LLM [5] 以非嵌入式FLOPs/每个令牌代表模型尺度,而Porian等人则代表模型尺度. [23]显示输出层计算,热量,和优化器调制是如何解释计算-优化缩放中的差异的. 这些研究为第一阶段的IsoFLOP与培训FLOP的一致核算比较提供了依据(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: The form of the loss surface determines how predictions vary across model sizes and training token counts. Skaling [ 27 ] couples the model and data terms through an outer exponent, reducing systematic residuals of the additive Chinchilla form. OpenEuroLLM [ 1 ] fitted this coupled surface to the lowest measured loss of each model–budget group. We adopt the coupled form and this fitting target for the base surface L ∗ ​ ( M , D ) L^{*}(M,D) , using training FLOPs per token M M as model scale, and add an LR–BS term to describe loss away from the predicted optima (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 损失表面的形式决定了预测在模型大小和训练符号计数上的差异. Skaling[27]通过一个外延子对模型和数据术语进行配对,减少添加剂Chinchilla形式的系统残留. Open EuropleLLM [1] 将这一偶联表面安装到每个模型-预算组的最低计量损失。 我们采用组合形式和这个合适的L*(M,D)L*(M,D)L*(D,D)基面目标,使用每兆兆令牌训练FLOP作为模型尺度,并增加一个LR-BS术语来描述远离预测的Ottima的损失(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: Hyperparameter scaling laws range from relationships along a prescribed training path to functions of model size and token count. DeepSeek LLM [ 5 ] fits optimal LR and BS along the compute-optimal path, whereas the Porian Law [ 23 ] describes a path at about 20 TPP. Microsoft Law [ 3 ] models optimal LR as a product of powers of model size and token count at a fixed BS. StepLaw [ 14 ] uses this product form for LR and a token-count-only power law for BS. OpenEuroLLM [ 1 ] first estimates optima from a quadratic LR–BS surface within each model–budget group, then fits product power laws for both LR and BS. We fit power laws for the optima through the losses of all swept runs and compare prior laws along the paths on which they are defined (Sections 4.2 and 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 超参数缩放定律从规定培训路径上的关系到模型大小和符号计数的功能不等。 DeepSeek LLM [5] 符合最优LR和BS沿计算-最佳路径,而Porian定律[23]则描述一条路径大约为20 TPP. Microsoft Law [3] models 最佳LR作为模型大小和符号计数在固定BS的功率产物. StepLaw [14] 对LR使用这种产品形式,对BS则使用只记号的权力法. Open EuralLLM [1] 首先从每个模型的LR-BS表面对Optima进行估算,然后符合LR和BS的产品功率定律. 我们通过所有横扫法的损耗来适应权力法,并按其定义的道路来比较以前的法律(第4.2和4.4节)。

blocks.en: Optimization theory provides a complementary basis for modeling the effect of LR and BS on loss. Shulgin et al. [25] derive a proxy for Muon-type optimization, and Su [26] analyzes generalized power-law proxies by minimizing first over LR and then over BS. Starting from the fixed-momentum Muon-type proxy, we derive its cosh representation in log space. This representation and the proxy’s square-root scaling of optimal LR with BS motivate our fixed-slope LR–BS term, which we combine with fitted power laws for the optima and curvature (Section 4.2 ; Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: OlmPool [ 2 ] directly studies how architectural choices affect long-context extension, finding that short-context metrics poorly predict the resulting long-context capabilities. It trains 7B models on about 140B pretraining tokens followed by 10B long-context tokens. Phase II adopts the same sequence of pretraining and long-context mid-training, using 1B models trained on 150B+10B tokens to evaluate architectural gains beyond the compute–loss comparisons of Phase I (Section 3.2 ). RULER [ 10 ] tests retrieval, multi-hop tracing, aggregation, and question answering with synthetic tasks; HELMET [ 29 ] covers a broader range of downstream applications. Phase II uses these benchmarks in the Base Long-Context suite and evaluates general capabilities with the Base Main suite (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: OlmPool [2] 直接研究建筑选择如何影响长文本扩展,发现短文本衡量标准对由此产生的长文本能力预测不佳. 它在大约140B的预训符上训练7B型号,之后是10B的长文符. 第二阶段采用相同的预训和长文中训序列,使用经过150B+10B标志培训的1B模型,评价第一阶段计算损失比较以外的建筑收益(第3.2节)。 RULLR [10]测试检索,多跳追踪,汇总,以及用合成任务回答问题;HELMET [29]涵盖更广泛的下游应用. 第二阶段在基地长文套件中使用这些基准,并用基地主套件评价一般能力(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: ArchSpace records, reviews, and references architecture experiments under a standardized validation framework with shared data and evaluation. In Phase I, loss is compared across the compute budgets of the scaling ladder. Phase II then evaluates downstream capabilities in 1B models after pretraining on 150B tokens and after long-context mid-training on 10B tokens. We provide Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baseline ladders, fitted scaling laws, measured recipes, and Phase II baselines as initial references for this workflow.
blocks.zh: ArchSpace记录,审查和参考架构实验在一个具有共享数据和评价的标准化验证框架下进行. 在第一阶段,在计算梯级时将损失进行比较。 第二阶段随后在150B令牌的预训后和10B令牌的长文中训后,对1B型的下游能力进行评估. 我们提供了Qune3.5和OLMo3基线梯子,安装了比例定律,测量了食谱,第二阶段基线,作为本工作流程的初步参考。

blocks.en: The scaling laws combine a coupled base surface with a fixed-slope cosh LR–BS term and fit the measured losses from both baseline ladders with a MAPE of 0.25%–0.27%. The coupled base surface fits the group minima more accurately than its additive ablation, and the fitted coupling exponents and data exponents of optimal BS are close to those in prior work. The frozen laws predict extrapolation losses at up to ten times the largest swept budget with a MAPE of 0.32%. These laws also give compute-optimal model sizes and training token counts. Locating optimal LR, however, is harder than predicting loss, so we use the predicted optima to initialize direct recipe searches.

blocks.en: In Phase II, Qwen3.5’s selected pretraining LR is about 3.6 times the predicted optimum at the same BS. Loss predictions nevertheless remain close to the measurements for both baselines. Long-context mid-training then raises the Base Main scores and establishes 64K long-context capability for both baselines. The recipe tuned for Qwen3.5 also yields large gains for OLMo3 when reused without tuning.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,Quen3.5选定的预训LR大约是同一BS的预测最佳水平的3.6倍。 然而,损失预测仍然接近于两个基线的测量。 然后,长编培训中期提高Base Main分数,并为两个基线建立64K长编能力。 Quen3.5调制的配方在不调制的情况下再利用时也会为OLMo3带来很大的收益.

blocks.en: With these baselines, ArchSpace offers the community an ongoing cycle of architecture research. Contributors introduce an idea through an Architecture Proposal, evaluate it under the validation framework, and submit the resulting record for public review. A Verified contribution can then become a new baseline for the next proposal. The reviewed records let later studies reproduce comparisons and reuse implementations. This cycle addresses the gaps identified at the start of this report: incomplete public records of the experiments and reasoning behind successful and unsuccessful architectural decisions, and research attention concentrated around industrial releases. ArchSpace aims to broaden the range of ideas that receive public review, citation, and recognition, making today’s baselines the starting points for tomorrow’s architecture research.
blocks.zh: 有了这些基线,ArchSpace为社区提供了一个持续的建筑研究周期. 撰稿人通过一个建筑建议提出一个想法,在验证框架下加以评价,并将由此产生的记录提交公众审查。 核证后的捐款可成为下一个提案的新基准。 经审查的记录允许以后的研究复制比较和再利用执行情况。 这个周期涉及本报告开头所发现的差距:关于成功和不成功的建筑决定背后的实验和推理的公开记录不完整,研究注意力集中在工业释放上。 ArchSpace旨在扩大获得公众评论、引用和认可的想法范围,使今天的基线成为明天建筑研究的起点。

We use momentum 0.9 and approximate the orthogonalization with five Newton–Schulz iterations using a fifth-degree polynomial, avoiding an explicit singular-value decomposition. Following the Muon update rule [ 15 ] , the optimization part of the matrix update is Δ ​ W t = − η t ​ 0.2 ​ max ⁡ ( d out , d in ) ​ O t , \Delta W_{t}=-\eta_{t}\,0.2\sqrt{\max(d_{\mathrm{out}},d_{\mathrm{in}})}\,O_{t}, (6) where O t O_{t} is the approximately orthogonalized momentum, d out d_{\mathrm{out}} and d in d_{\mathrm{in}} are the dimensions of the matrix being orthogonalized, and η t \eta_{t} is the scheduled LR. The root mean square of O t O_{t} varies with the matrix dimensions. The square-root factor compensates for this variation, and the factor 0.2 scales the update to a magnitude near that of AdamW. blocks.en: D.2 Fitting order
blocks.zh: D.2 交接顺序

blocks.en: In the two-stage procedure, we fit L ∗ L^{*} first and hold it fixed while fitting Δ ​ L \Delta L (Appendix C.2 ). We test whether fitting the two terms simultaneously gives more accurate loss predictions. Both approaches use the same functional forms and equal weighting. The LR–BS term takes the log-quadratic form h ⁡ [ ( η ~ − γ η , B ​ B ~ ) 2 + ρ ​ B ~ 2 ] h[(\widetilde{\eta}-\gamma_{\eta,B}\widetilde{B})^{2}+\rho\widetilde{B}^{2}] (Appendix C.1 ); its slope γ η , B \gamma_{\eta,B} and curvature ratio ρ \rho are fitted in both approaches. Table 21 reports errors on the swept runs and on runs excluded from fitting.
blocks.zh: 在两阶段程序中,我们先装上L * L^{*},然后在装上L\Delta L(附录C.2)时固定它。 我们测试两个术语是否同时配对 给出更准确的损失预测。 两种方法都采用相同的功能形式和同等的权重. LR-BS术语采用log-quadratic形式 h⁡[(η~~~~~~~~~~~,B~~~)2 + ρ B ]] h [(\glasstilde\eta]-\gammal_{\eta,B}\syldilde{B}](附录C.1);其坡度 γ,B\ma_{\eta,B}]和曲率 → rho 两种方法都适用. 表21报告扫描运行和运行中的错误,不包括安装。

blocks.en: On the swept runs, the base surface from two-stage fitting predicts the group minima more accurately, while simultaneous fitting gives similar or lower loss error across all points by allowing L ∗ L^{*} and Δ ​ L \Delta L to adjust together. For runs excluded from fitting, simultaneous fitting predicts loss more accurately on the extrapolation runs but less accurately on the 150B-token pretraining sweep. We retain two-stage fitting because it preserves the fit of the base surface to the group minima used to determine the IsoFLOP curves and compute-optimal model sizes and training token counts.
blocks.zh: 在扫荡运行时,从两阶段安装的基面可以更准确地预测组型迷你马,同时安装则通过让L → L 和 → L → Delta L 一起调整来在所有点上给出类似的或较低的损失错误. 对于不包括装配的运行,同时装配更准确地预测了外推运行的损失,但对150B托肯预训扫描更不准确. 我们保留了两阶段的装配,因为它保留了基础表面对用于确定IsoFLOP曲线和计算最佳模型尺寸和训练符号计数的组型迷你体的装配。

blocks.zh: 表21:与斜率和曲率相符的LR-BS对数值的交配顺序。 两阶段配对估计 L * LQQ来自组迷你马,在装配 L\Delta L时保持固定;同时配对估计来自所有扫荡运行的损失。

blocks.en: D.3 Form of the LR–BS term
blocks.zh: D.3 LR-BS术语的形式

blocks.en: We compare four LR–BS forms to test how accurately they predict loss and locate the optimal LR and BS (Table 22 ). The alternatives are a form that retains the proxy shape (Appendix C.1 ), the log-quadratic form, and cosh forms with fitted or fixed LR–BS slopes. The log-quadratic form generalizes the proxy’s second-order expansion by fitting the slope and curvature ratio. Each alternative uses power laws for its optima and amplitude, with optimal BS depending on both M M and D D (Section 4.4 ). We fit these forms using the same fitted base surface and losses from all swept runs. Alongside loss MAPE, the table reports the MAPE of the predicted optima relative to the best measured configuration of each model–budget group.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了4个LR-BS表格,以测试它们如何准确预测损失并定位最佳LR和BS(表22)。 替代品是一种保留代用形状(附录C.1),log-quadratic形式,以及装配或固定的LR-BS斜面的cosh形式。 log-quadratic通过安装坡度和曲率来概括代理的二阶扩展。 每种选择都使用权力法进行选用和振幅,最佳BS取决于MM和DD(第4.4节)。 我们用同样的底部表面 和所有扫荡造成的损失来装配这些表格 除了MAPE损失之外,该表还报告了相对于每个模型-预算组的最佳计量配置而言,预测选择图的MAPE。

blocks.en: The form that retains the proxy shape has the largest loss error across all swept runs. Compared with the log-quadratic form, both cosh forms reduce all-point loss MAPE from 0.28% to 0.25% for Qwen3.5 and from 0.31% to 0.27% for OLMo3. Fitting the slope gives γ η , B = 0.77 \gamma_{\eta,B}=0.77 for Qwen3.5 and 0.51 for OLMo3, with nearly the same loss MAPE as fixing it. For Qwen3.5, however, fitting the slope raises the MAPE of the predicted optimal LR to 50.0%, compared with 34.5% for the log-quadratic form. Compared with fitting the cosh slope, fixing it gives an LR MAPE of 35.1% with one fewer parameter and nearly the same loss MAPE. We therefore adopt the cosh form with γ η , B = 1 / 2 \gamma_{\eta,B}=1/2 for both baseline ladders. Section 4.3 compares the resulting contours with the measured LR–BS dependence.
blocks.zh: 保留代理形状的窗体在所有横扫运行中的损失错误最大. 与log-quadratic形式相比,两个cosh形式将全点损失MAPE从0.28%降至0.25%(Qune3.5),将OLMo3从0.31%降至0.27%. 倾斜给 QQ , B = 0.77\gamma_{\eta, B = 0.77 的 Qwen3.5 和 OLMo3 的 0.51 , 损失 MAPE 几乎与修复相同。 然而,在Quen3.5中,坡度将预测最佳LR的MAPE提高到50.0%,而对数方形则为34.5%。 与装配螺旋坡相比,固定它的LR MAPE为35.1%,参数少一个,损失几乎相同。 因此,我们采用以“+,B = 1 / 2\gamma_{\eta,B + 1/2”为基准梯的cosh形式。 第4.3节将由此产生的轮廓与经测量的LR-BS依赖性进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 22: Each alternative LR–BS form is fitted using the same base surface and losses from all swept runs. The Best-point and All-point columns report loss MAPE on group minima and all runs; the η ∗ \eta^{*} and B ∗ B^{*} columns report MAPE against the best measured configuration of each group. Parameter counts include the base surface. Bold marks the adopted form.
blocks.zh: 表22:每个LR-BS表格都采用相同的基表面和所有冲刷产生的损失。 Best-point 和 All-point 栏报告小组迷你和所有运行的 MAPE 损失; Q *\eta *和B * B 栏报告 MAPE 与每个小组的最佳测量配置相对应。 参数计数包括基面. 粗体标出通过的形式。

blocks.en: D.4 Shared versus per-group estimation of the optima
blocks.zh: D.4 国家 对Ottima的共享和每组估算

blocks.en: We test whether estimating the optima separately for each model–budget group is more accurate than using the shared LR–BS term. OpenEuroLLM estimates the optima by fitting a quadratic surface to the losses in each group [ 1 ] . We fit each quadratic in log LR and log BS, retaining fits with a full-rank design matrix, a positive-definite quadratic, and a minimum strictly inside the convex hull of the tested points. These fits cover 24 of the 27 groups for Qwen3.5 and 25 of 27 for OLMo3. We then fit power laws in M M and D D to the retained minima.
blocks.zh: 我们测试对每个模型-预算组分别进行选择图估计是否比使用共享的LR-BS术语更准确. Open EuralLLM通过为每组损失安装一个四面体来估计Otima。 我们把每个四进制在对数LR和对数BS中,保留一个全等级设计矩阵,一个正定式四进制,并严格在试验点的对流壳内。 这两组共27组,其中24组为Quen3.5组,25组为OLMo3组。 然后把M和DD中的权力法 适用于保留下来的迷你人

blocks.en: When evaluated against these minima, the per-group power laws attain lower MAPE than the shared LR–BS term, which is fitted to losses from all swept runs. The LR errors are 11.3% versus 16.6% for Qwen3.5 and 5.4% versus 12.5% for OLMo3. The BS errors are 9.9% versus 10.5% for Qwen3.5 and 6.2% versus 7.5% for OLMo3.
blocks.zh: 当对照这些微型资产进行评估时,每组权力法的MAPE比共同的LR-BS术语要低,后者适合所有冲浪造成的损失。 LR误差为11.3%,而Quen3.5为16.6%,OLMo3为5.4%,而OLMo3为12.5%。 BS误差为9.9%,Quen3.5为10.5%,OLMo3为6.2%,7.5%。

blocks.en: The per-group power laws, however, predict only the optimal LR and BS. The shared LR–BS term also predicts loss away from its optima and the optimal LR at a fixed BS (Equation 12 ). We therefore retain the shared term, using the per-group minima as a separate check of its predicted optima. At an imposed BS, the LR predicted by the shared term should be used to initialize the Setting 3 search (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 然而,每组权力法只预测最佳LR和BS. 共享的LR-BS术语还预测在固定的BS(方程式12 )中远离其opima和最佳LR的损失. 因此,我们保留了这个共同的术语,将每个组的迷你词作为对其预测的选用词的单独检查. 在强制进行BS时,应当使用共同术语预言的LR来初始化设定3搜索(第3.1节).

blocks.en: Appendix E Phase II Baselines: Configuration and Results
blocks.zh: 附录E 第二阶段 基线:配置和结果

blocks.en: E.1 Configuration and evaluation
blocks.zh: E.1 配置和评价

blocks.en: The Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 Phase II baselines use the 24-layer shapes in Table 12 and the shared optimizer and initialization settings in Appendix B . Pretraining uses 8K context and a 2,000-update warmup. A square-root decay over the final 20% of updates reduces the LR to 10% of its peak.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5和OLMo3第二阶段基线使用表12中的24层形状以及附录B中的共享优化和初始化设置。 Pretrain使用8K上下文和2000年更新热身. 最终20%更新的平方根衰变使LR降低到峰值的10%.

blocks.en: Each long-context mid-training run then restores the model and optimizer state of the selected pretrained checkpoint and trains on about 10B tokens of the Dolma 3 Longmino Mix (50B) at 64K context. This stage uses a 200-update warmup followed by a stable LR and a square-root decay to zero over the final 20% of updates.
blocks.zh: 每次长文训练中跑,然后在64K上下文的多尔马3型龙米诺Mix(50B)的约10B令牌上,恢复选定预训检查站和列车的型号和优化状态. 这一阶段采用200更新热身,然后是稳定的LR和方根衰变,超过最后20%的更新.

blocks.en: Long-context mid-training retains document boundaries within the 64K sequences [ 19 ] . Attention is causal within each document and masked across documents, and rotary positions restart at each boundary.
blocks.zh: Long-context 中训保留64K序列内的文档边界[19]. 注意是每份文件的因果关系,并遮盖文件,在每个边界重新开始旋转位置。

blocks.en: At 64K context, Qwen3.5 retains its pretraining RoPE base of 1 × 10 7 1\times 10^{7} and rotary fraction of 0.25 without further positional scaling. By contrast, OLMo3 applies YaRN scaling [ 21 ] with factor 8 to the rotary embeddings of its full-attention layers; its sliding-window layers retain their pretraining position encoding.
blocks.zh: 在64K上下文中,Quen3.5保留其预训RoPE基数为1×10 7 1\times 10^{7}旋转分数为0.25,没有进一步的定位缩放. 相比之下,OLMo3将YARN缩放[21]与因子8应用到其全心层的旋转嵌入;其滑动-窗口层保留其预训位置编码.

blocks.en: The LR and BS selected in Appendices E.2 and E.4 form the Qwen3.5 baseline recipe, which OLMo3 reuses for both stages (Table 23 ). Section 5.3 describes the evaluation of the resulting checkpoints and reports the principal Base Main and Base Long-Context results.
blocks.zh: 附录E.2和E.4中选定的LR和BS构成Quen3.5基准食谱,OLMo3在两个阶段都重复使用(表23)。 第5.3节说明了对由此设立的检查站的评价,并报告了主要基地主干线和基地长线结果。

blocks.en: Table 23: Phase II baseline recipe, selected for Qwen3.5 and reused for OLMo3 without tuning (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 表23:第二阶段基准食谱,选作Quen3.5,再用于OLMo3,不调音(第5节)。

blocks.en: E.2 Pretraining sweep
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 预训扫描

blocks.en: The Qwen3.5 pretraining sweep starts from the predicted optima in Table 7 . At BS 4M, the tested peak LR values extend up to 5e-3 and bracket the LR of the lowest-loss recipe. Fewer LR values are tested at BS 2M and 8M. Table 8 lists every run with its Base Main scores and the loss predicted by the frozen scaling law. Figure 6 shows the sweep’s TPP relative to the baseline ladders.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.5 预训扫描从表7中的预测opima开始。 在BS 4M中,经过测试的峰值LR值可达5e-3,并将最低损失食谱的LR值划入档次。 在BS 2M和8M测试的LR值较少. 表8列出了每一次运行,其Base Main得分和被冻结的缩放法预测的损失. 图6显示扫荡的TPP相对于基线梯级.

blocks.en: The pretraining sweep extends beyond the baseline ladder in TPP and uses a different warmup schedule. The ladder uses a fixed token count for warmup, whereas the sweep uses a fixed update count. The sweep’s warmup fraction therefore increases with BS (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 训练前扫荡扩展至TPP的基线阶梯以外,并使用不同的热身表. 梯子使用固定的符号计数进行热身,而扫荡则使用固定的更新计数. 扫荡的热量随BS(附录E.1)而增加。

blocks.en: The frozen scaling law overpredicts every measured loss, with a MAPE of 1.02%. At the selected recipe, the overprediction is 1.52% for the full law and 1.03% for the base surface alone. The selected LR lies above the predicted optimum at the same BS, so the LR–BS term increases the overprediction (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 冻结的缩放定律对每一次测定的损失都进行了过度预测,最低比率为1.02%。 在选定的食谱中,对完全定律的过度预测为1.52%,仅基面的过度预测为1.03%。 选定的LR位于同一BS的预测最佳值之上,因此LR-BS术语增加了过度预测(第5.1节).

blocks.en: Downstream task rankings differ from the ranking by final validation loss. Table 24 compares the lowest-loss recipe with close alternatives on benchmarks evaluated separately from the Base Main suite. A higher-loss alternative performs best on each benchmark shown, and the best recipe varies by task. We consider these task-dependent rankings when selecting the pretraining recipe (Section 5.1 ).

blocks.en: E.3 Effect of the decay
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 衰变的影响

blocks.en: The pretraining runs change rank during LR decay (Figure 10 ). Before decay, loss increases with peak LR at every tested BS; across all runs, 8e-4/4M ranks first and 3e-3/4M eighth. During decay, loss falls by 0.09 to 0.18, generally more at higher peak LR, consistent with the sharp loss reduction during the cooldown of WSD schedules [ 8 ] . At the final checkpoint, 3e-3/4M ranks first and 8e-4/4M last. This reversal supports comparing the final checkpoints of complete schedules, as required in Phase II.
blocks.zh: 预训在LR衰变时运行变化等级(图10). 在衰变前,损失随着每一次测试的BS的峰值LR增加;在所有运行中,8e-4/4M排名第一,3e-3/4M排名第八. 在衰变期间,损失下降0.09至0.18,一般在较高的峰值LR时较多,这与WSD时刻表冷却过程中急剧减少损失一致[8]. 在最后的检查站,3e-3/4M排名第一,8e-4/4M排名最后. 这一逆转有助于按照第二阶段的要求,对完整时间表的最后检查站进行比较。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Loss measured before decay (a) and reduction during decay (b) in the Qwen3.5 pretraining sweep. Subtracting the reduction from the loss before decay gives the final loss in Table 8 , showing how recipe rankings change during decay.
blocks.zh: 图10:在Quen3.5预训扫荡中,在衰变(a)之前测得的损失和衰变(b)期间的减少。 在衰减前从损失中减去减少额,则得出表8中的最后损失,表明食谱排名在衰减期间的变化。

blocks.en: E.4 Long-context mid-training
blocks.zh: E.4 长期培训

blocks.en: The scaling laws are fitted to losses measured in the baseline ladders and do not apply to long-context mid-training. We therefore sweep LR and BS directly for Qwen3.5 rather than starting from predicted optima. At the pretraining BS of 4M, peak LR ranges from the final pretraining LR, 3e-4, to the pretraining peak, 3e-3; fewer LR values are tested at a doubled BS of 8M. Table 25 reports Base Main scores and 64K RULER and HELMET scores for every run.
blocks.zh: 缩放定律适用于基线梯度测得的损失,不适用于长式中训。 因此,我们直接将LR和BS扫描到Quen3.5,而不是从预测的Otima开始。 在4M的预训BS中,峰值LR从最后的预训LR,3e-4到预训峰值3e-3不等;在8M的双倍比S中测试的LR值较少. 表25 报告 基础主分和64K RULLR和HELMET的分数每跑一次.

Long-context scores for the pretrained checkpoint are reference measurements. Base Main input limits are 8K for the pretrained checkpoint and 64K for the mid-trained checkpoints. Figure 8 plots the Base Main and long-context scores, and Table 26 gives long-context results at each evaluation length.
blocks.zh: 表25: 文3.5 长文训练中段扫描: 基础主分和64K RULLR和HELMET的分数每跑一次. 预训检查站的长写分数是参考测量. 基地主输入限值为8K预训检查站,64K为中训检查站. 图8列出了Base Main和长文本分数,表26列出了每个评价长度的长文本结果。

blocks.zh: Doubling BS降低64K RULLR和HELMET在LR 1e-3的分数,但以3e-3提高. 在BS 8M中,两者的分数均随LR增长,最高达到测试值最大.

blocks.en: Long-context mid-training also preserves RULER performance as the evaluation length grows (Figure 8 a,b and Table 26 ). At 64K, beyond the 8K pretraining window, the pretrained checkpoint retains 27% of its 4K RULER score, compared with 66%–71% for the mid-trained checkpoints. Among the tested recipes, the selected run has the highest RULER score at 64K, the length targeted by Phase II, while 3e-3/4M scores highest at 4K and 8K. Table 27 gives the 64K scores by category.
blocks.zh: 随着评价时间的延长,长篇培训中期也保持了欧盟驻科法治团的业绩(图8a、b和表26)。 在64K时,在8K预训窗口之外,预训检查站保留了4K Rullar分数的27%,而中训检查站则保留了66%–71%. 在经过测试的食谱中,所选的跑步成绩最高的RULAR得分为64K,为第二阶段目标长度,而3e-3/4M得分最高的是4K和8K. 表27按类别列出64K分数.

RULER categories are needle-in-a-haystack retrieval (Retr.), multi-hop tracing (Multi-hop), aggregation (Aggr.), and question answering (QA). HELMET categories are synthetic recall (Recall), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), passage re-ranking (Rerank), many-shot in-context learning (ICL), and long-document QA (LongQA).
blocks.zh: 表27:64K的Wen3.5类分数;预训检查站的分数为参考度量. 欧盟驻科法治团的类别是针入海斯塔克检索(Retr),多跳追踪(Multi-hop),聚合(Aggr)和问答(QA). HELMET的类别是合成召回(Recall),检索增强生成(RAG),通道重排(Rerank),多镜头内语学习(ICL),以及长文件QA(LongQA).

blocks.en: Appendix F Literature Survey Methodology
blocks.zh: 附录F 文学 调查方法

blocks.en: The survey covers language-model architecture studies from November 2023 to October 2026, including multimodal models, with no minimum parameter count. Eligible papers described changes to a model’s internal computation and reported training or evaluation experiments. Studies limited to data, optimization, prompting, or execution efficiency were excluded unless they included architectural changes.
blocks.zh: 调查范围包括2023年11月至2026年10月的语言模型建筑研究,包括多式联运模型,没有最小参数数. 合格的论文描述了模型内部计算的变化和报告的培训或评价实验。 仅限于数据、优化、提示或执行效率的研究被排除在外,除非这些研究包括建筑改变。

blocks.en: To identify eligible papers, we searched titles and abstracts across all arXiv categories, then used AI-assisted screening and targeted full-text checks.
blocks.zh: 为了确定合格的文件,我们搜索所有ArXiv类别的标题和摘要,然后使用AI协助筛选和有针对性的全文检查。

blocks.en: Figure 1 compares work from universities and independent researchers alone with work involving industry. We classified a paper as work involving industry if at least one author was affiliated with a company, government body, independent research institution, or non-university nonprofit, including dual affiliations. We obtained affiliations from formal publications or arXiv versions and also used verified information about authors’ employment at the time of publication; funding alone did not determine the group.
blocks.zh: 图1将大学和独立研究人员单独开展的工作与涉及工业的工作进行比较。 如果至少有一位作者隶属于一家公司、政府机构、独立研究机构或非大学非营利机构,包括双重隶属关系,我们便将论文归类为涉及工业的作品。 我们从正式出版物或arXiv版本中获得了联系,并在出版时也使用了经核实的关于作者就业的资料;仅靠资金不能确定这一群体。

blocks.en: Each paper was counted once by publication date, using its earliest documented public release or its first arXiv submission when no earlier date was established. The figure spans 23Q4 – 26Q3 , with 2,919 papers in the paper-count plot. The three-month periods are labeled Q1 for February–April, Q2 for May–July, Q3 for August–October, and Q4 for November–January of the following year.
blocks.zh: 每份论文在出版日期之前计算一次,采用最早的公开公开发布文件,或在未确定较早日期时首次提交。 这一数字跨度为23Q4 — 26Q3,纸币图案中有2,919份论文. 三个月的期间标注为2-4月的Q1,5-7月的Q2,8-10月的Q3,次年11-1月的Q4.

blocks.en: The citation plot contains 117,629 cumulative citations to 2,859 papers from the same periods. We retrieved citation counts from Semantic Scholar on October 31, 2026. We matched papers to Semantic Scholar records only when both the arXiv identifiers and normalized titles agreed; unmatched papers were excluded. In each plot, bars show group totals and the line shows the share of papers or citations for work involving industry. Citation totals are grouped by publication date and are unadjusted for paper count or age.
blocks.zh: 引用情节包含117,629份累计引用的同期论文2,859篇. 我们于2026年10月31日从语义学者那里检索到引用的数。 只有当ArXiv识别标志和正常名称都同意时,我们才将论文与语义学者记录相匹配;没有匹配的论文被排除在外。 在每个情节中,栏杆显示团体总数,线条显示涉及行业的论文或引文的比例. 引用总数按公布日期分类,不按纸张清点或年代调整。
